title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: A “stair-step” figure is made up of alternating shaded and unshaded squares in each row. Rows \(1\) through \(4\) are shown. All rows begin and end with an unshaded square. The number of shaded squares in the \(37\)th row is

solutions.text:
Row \(n\) contains \(2n - 1\) squares. Because both ends are unshaded and the squares alternate, each row has one more unshaded square than shaded square, so the number of shaded squares is \(n - 1.\)

For the \(37\)th row, this is \(37 - 1 = 36.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
